text:
Maya: Quick idea ">Pocket Arcade Binge" at my place Saturday afternoon? Bring handhelds & chargers.
Ethan: Love it. I'll bring my Steam Deck and a couple indie titles.
Leo: I'll bring Switch + Mario Kart. Also a tiny projector if we want a shared screen.
Sofia: I'm in. Can I bring a friend who collects retro handhelds?
Maya: Yup, friend welcome. Planning 2-6pm so folks can drop in. Snacks welcome.
swap-bot: Poll created: "Bring/Swap handheld accessories?" Options: Cables, Cases, SD cards, Nothing. React +1 to vote.
Ethan: +1 SD cards, +1 Cables
Leo: +1 Cables
Sofia: +1 Cases
Maya: Tally: Cables 2, SD cards 1, Cases 1. Looks like cables win. I'll bring a multi USB hub.
Ethan: Also can we do a tiny high-score leaderboard for arcade runs? 10-minute sets, top score wins a silly sticker.
Leo: Sticker incentive = chef's kiss. I'll print a bracket for mini tournaments too.
Sofia: I'll bring labels so things don't get mixed up. Last meetup we had a mystery charger again. :sweat_smile:
Maya: Parking: street parking okay after 3pm. I'll DM the address. Please RSVP if plans change. See you for tiny screens and big competition! :video_game:
